{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the `revenue` column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# According to the data dictionary, refunded orders should not count toward revenue
net_sales = real_sales[real_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of completed orders
print(f"Number of completed (non-refunded) orders: {len(net_sales)}")

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = net_sales.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
print("\nTotal revenue by channel (after removing QA and refunded orders):")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"\nChannel with the most revenue: {max_channel} ({max_revenue:,.2f})")"}
